sections.body: PERIMETER is the distance all the way around a shape. Add up all the sides.
AREA is the space inside. For a rectangle: length × width. It's measured in square units (cm²).
A right angle is 90° (like a square corner). Acute angles are smaller than 90°; obtuse angles are between 90° and 180°.
The angles inside any triangle always add up to 180°.

quiz.q: A rectangle is 5 cm long and 3 cm wide. What is its AREA?
hints: Area of a rectangle = length × width.
A 4 cm by 2 cm rectangle has area 4 × 2 = 8 cm².

quiz.q: Two angles of a triangle are 90° and 60°. What is the third?
hints: Angles in a triangle add to 180°.
If two angles are 100° and 50°, the third is 180 − 150 = 30°. Try yours.
